title: Landfall and Trail
author: Edmund Dravenmoor
blurb: Petra Halloran, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
